content: {"episode_id":"ep-05024","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry) was ordered for a patient with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness (R42) in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10) and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). The monitoring was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes. We request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial and review of the enclosed records."}
